limitations: Ordered incomplete corpus; not a random sample or final prevalence estimate.
Reviewer labels are not independent factual proof.
Math support labels may require category consistency audit.
decision: Use full completed review to construct capability-balanced data. Preserve a verified basic-reasoning/task-routing stream and retained speech/control objectives; do not treat a large explanatory corpus as sufficient arithmetic/routing training. Externally supported factual claims need qualification before admission, and all original failures remain recorded.
